findings.title: Production delivery does not instruct a general Worker OMP how to emit the required control response
findings.evidence: bridge.ts strictly accepts WB_WORKER_RESPONSE plus one exact 12-field compact JSON object, but the injected delivery body and execute/analysis instructions contain no marker, fields, or decision contract. Actual probes pass only because the scripted provider hardcodes the format.
findings.impact: A normal worker responds naturally or uses tools, the bridge rejects the response, and C-AC-03/C-AC-05 production execution/reporting remains held.

resolved_prior_finding: Private provider response-store dependence is closed by production G3WorkerResponsePort and public events.
qualification: Synthetic willContinue handling does not match the installed OMP event type and is not counted as a separate defect; terminal agent_end plus additional-provider-round rejection remain the current supported boundary.
